newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:

- House Republican leaders went to the television talk shows Sunday to rally behind Speaker Newt Gingrich, arguing that his confessed ethics lapses were minor matters that should not bar his re-election as Speaker.
- Now that there are changes in the Federal welfare law, those who fail the U.S. citizenship test will no longer automatically be entitled to the government money that most of them need to live.
- Shoppers stepped up their spending on the final weekend before Christmas.
- For all the worrisome cries about the "mallification" of America, shopping malls have become as much a part of the holiday season as community group renditions of Handel's "Messiah."

- Television news magazines have become the target of a new form of legal attack, as individuals and companies have increasing success with the argument that the use of hidden cameras tramples on their rights.
